title: Tiers, matrices and categories are made on pages, not in dialogs
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  5. Click New Matrix.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Open Settings › Categories.
  8. Click New Category.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • A New Tier page opens, not a dialog.

Step 3:

  • The Tiers list shows again.

Step 4:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 5:

  • A New Matrix page opens with its grid, not a dialog.

Step 6:

  • The Matrices list shows again.

Step 7:

  • The Categories page shows.

Step 8:

  • A New Category page opens, not a dialog.
